message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians can take advantage of in 2023.  
(These are the federal holidays that either fall on a Friday/Monday or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend.  Province‑specific holidays that create long weekends—such as Family Day in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, etc.—are listed where they apply.)

| Long Weekend | Holiday(s) | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|------------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed) | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday Jan 1; observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, BC, NB, NL, PEI) | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Third Monday in February. (Not observed in all provinces.) |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **May 20 – May 22** | Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed) | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day fell on Saturday Jul 1; observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day (observed) | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday Nov 11; observed on Monday Nov 13. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas fell on Monday Dec 25; the preceding weekend (Dec 23‑24) is part of the long weekend. |

### Quick Tips for Planning

1. **Check Province‑Specific Holidays** – If you’re planning trips in provinces that observe Family Day (e.g., Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, NB, NL, PEI), you’ll have an extra long weekend in February.  
2. **Observe “Observed” Dates** – When a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* date (usually the following Monday) is what creates the long weekend.  
3. **Combine with Travel** – Many people combine these long weekends with a short trip to nearby cities or natural attractions.  

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app, and let me know if you’d like province‑specific long weekends or any other details!
